name: Guru
description: Guru's MCP Server connects Anthropic's Claude to your company's trusted knowledge layer, so every AI answer is grounded in verified, permission-aware information—not outdated docs or hallucinations. It links Claude to the same governed context your teams use, ensuring consistent, cited, and explainable responses. With built-in verification and lineage, the Guru MCP Server makes it easy for Claude to deliver answers you can trust across every workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Guru to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Guru to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.getguru.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Guru MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guru provides these MCP tools: answer_generation, create_draft, search_documents, update_card, list_knowledge_agents, and get_card_by_id.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Guru?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Guru in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Guru requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Guru is developed by Guru. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
